arStrings.szText: No. I can’t. What I've seen reeks of foul play. But none of it is damning.
The world is turning inside out. You’ve already been caught in the gyre—I'll not join you without solid proof.
Then don’t. But throw us a rope, at least.
We came hoping to learn about an artifact of the Temple. I’ve a hunch it’s what drew the Hands’ attention, too.
Hm. A mess this ugly begs for investigation... Very well.
I helped some of the Archivists build a barricade when the fighting broke out. If they’ve survived, perhaps they can tell you what you wish to know.
